target: Q4_combined_ev, coin btc, arms composed_lgbm and composed_linear, budgets 5/10/15%
population: the 08-25 development eval population, 177,674 actions / 311,640 rows
design: draw n matched samples of the SAME cancellation count, STRATIFIED BY (side, hour), compared on NET CENTS
n_draws_why: the Q4 family is 6 cells, so the Holm threshold for the smallest p is 0.05/6 = 0.008333. n=200 gives a floor of 1/201 = 0.004975, under 2x headroom below that. n=500 gives 1/501 = 0.001996, over 4x. n=2000 buys resolution the family cannot use.
n_draws_independently_derived: 500 was chosen from the Holm-headroom argument BEFORE reading N_RANDOM_011; the programme's own constant is also 500
sidedness: ONE-SIDED, alternative = the policy BEATS matched-random
a_pass_changes_the_diagnosis_not_the_ver: the declared gate is 'beats matched-random AND beats the incumbent'; the incumbent leg is not satisfied (holm_p 0.1199-0.4463, all above 0.05), so a matched-random pass cannot make the cell survive
population_is_consumed: 08-25 is the freeze's own training split, already consumed under rule 11 per be_operating_point_declaration_v1.derived_from_split; recomputing a null on it spends no forward day
